title: Shuffle and skew
summary: Synthetic PySpark notes designed to exercise longer code and list blocks.

blocks.text: A shuffle moves data between partitions. Large or uneven keys can make one task much slower than the others.

blocks.title: Illustrative aggregation
blocks.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

summary = (
    events.groupBy("customer_id")
          .agg(F.count("*").alias("events"),
               F.sum("amount").alias("amount"))
)
summary.explain("formatted")
